title: openOODA Compiler + Runtime
tagline: The substrate. Compiler (oodac) + Gen 1 C runtime. v2.11.x.
content:
## What it is

The oda monorepo holds the openOODA compiler (`oodac/`), the Gen 1 C runtime shims (`runtime/`), smoke tests, and fixtures. Every other openOODA repo builds on top of this substrate.

Full docs pull is queued behind gemini's compiler work. In the meantime, the source is at `openOODA/ooda/docs/` and the monorepo is at github.com/openOODA/ooda.

## Install

Not applicable — oda is the substrate, not a package. `oodac` ships with the `ooda` toolchain.

## Surface

| Component | Path | Role |
|-----------|------|------|
| Compiler | `oodac/` | Lexer, parser, Merkle AST, SSA mem2reg, direct ELF64 emission |
| Runtime | `runtime/` | Gen 1 C shims, Landlock sandbox, linear arenas |
| Smoke tests | `smoke/` | End-to-end compiler tests |
| Fixtures | `fixtures/` | Test inputs and expected outputs |

The compiler accepts 4 targets: `elf` (x86_64/AArch64), `wasm` (WasmGC), `c99` (portable C), and `llvm` (LLVM IR).

## Version contract

```
name=ooda
version=2.11.0
caps=15
api_surface=8
```

Bump MAJOR on breaking changes to memory invariants or capability ABI. Bump MINOR for non-breaking feature additions. Bump PATCH for bug repairs.

See the 6 existing docs in `ooda/docs/` for current details: `CAP_BOUNDARY.oot`, `TOKEN_OPT.oot`, `silent-miscompile-prevention.oot`, `x86-codegen-style.oot`, and others.
